flags.message: Independent verification of Bost was unavailable: CourtListener MCP returned HTTP 429 and official-site web attempts returned no usable output. Its possible effect on sanctions is inferred from both provisioned briefs and materially informs the GVR probability; no target-case outcome was sought or retrieved.

The provisioned opposition mentions denial of certiorari in 23-1021, the plaintiffs' separate appeal from dismissal. This is not the target attorney-sanctions petition 25-882 and was not treated as its outcome.
